# NBC Sports

> > NBC Sports delivers comprehensive coverage of major sports leagues, college athletics, and international sports with live scores, news, highlights, and fantasy sports integration.

NBC Sports is a leading digital sports destination covering the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NASCAR, Premier League soccer, college football, college basketball, and horse racing. The site integrates with Peacock TV for streaming and provides extensive player updates, injury reports, fantasy sports tools, and real-time game coverage across all major American sports leagues.

## Key Topics

- NFL
- NBA
- MLB
- NHL
- March Madness
- NCAA Tournament
- College Football

- Player Updates
- Injury Reports
- Peacock TV
- ProFootballTalk

## Major League Sports Hubs

- [NBC Sports Homepage](https://www.nbcsports.com): NBC Sports homepage with latest sports news, scores, and coverage
- [NFL Football](https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl): NFL hub with news, live coverage, player updates, and fantasy football
- [NBA Basketball](https://www.nbcsports.com/nba): NBA hub with news, live scores, game schedules, and Peacock TV streaming
- [MLB Baseball](https://www.nbcsports.com/mlb): MLB hub with news, live coverage, highlights, stats, and fantasy baseball
- [NHL Hockey](https://www.nbcsports.com/nhl): NHL hub with news, trades, player contracts, and hockey highlights

## College Sports & Tournaments

- [College Football](https://www.nbcsports.com/college-football): College football hub with Big Ten news, player highlights, and recruitment
- [College Basketball](https://www.nbcsports.com/mens-college-basketball): College basketball hub with March Madness, NCAA Tournament, and brackets
- [Women's College Basketball](https://www.nbcsports.com/womens-college-basketball/news/prince-scores-22-nebraska-women-beat-richmond-75-56-at-ncaa-first-four): Nebraska women's basketball NCAA First Four game recap vs Richmond
- [March Madness First Four](https://www.nbcsports.com/mens-college-basketball/news/prairie-view-a-m-defeats-lehigh-67-55-in-the-first-four-for-its-first-march-madness-win): Prairie View A&M March Madness First Four victory over Lehigh recap

## International & Alternative Sports

- [Premier League Soccer](https://www.nbcsports.com/soccer/premier-league): Premier League hub with news, live scores, match results, and highlights
- [NASCAR](https://www.nbcsports.com/nascar): NASCAR hub with Cup Series news, race results, and live coverage
- [Horse Racing](https://www.nbcsports.com/horse-racing): Horse racing hub with Breeders Cup, stakes races, and thoroughbred coverage

## Team Coverage

- [Washington Commanders](https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/washington-commanders): Washington Commanders team hub with news, scores, stats, and roster info
- [New York Yankees](https://www.nbcsports.com/mlb/new-york-yankees): New York Yankees team hub with news, scores, stats, and spring training
- [St. Louis Cardinals](https://www.nbcsports.com/mlb/st-louis-cardinals): St. Louis Cardinals team hub with news, scores, stats, and injury updates

- [ProFootballTalk](https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/profootballtalk): ProFootballTalk with Mike Florio NFL news, rumors, and analysis

- [NBA Division Race Analysis](https://www.nbcsports.com/watch/nba/nba-southeast-division-spicy-heading-to-an-exciting-finish): NBA Southeast Division playoff race analysis and division standings
